notes: Cover panel re-shoot of varq-18-zafrani: standing, full length, headroom for the tall crop.
prompt: Editorial fashion photograph for an Indian handloom label's festive lookbook. Tall vertical 9:16 frame.
GARMENT (a real product; match the reference photos exactly, including colours, borders and motifs):
- Saree: the saffron-ochre mul cotton saree from the first three references, printed with a fine gold foil jaal of scalloped lines and tiny dots, gold lace edge and navy tassels. Soft, matte, airy.
- Blouse: the deep purple silk brocade blouse with gold lotus motifs from the last two references, elbow-length sleeves.
- Pallu tucked at the waist kitchen-style, showing the gold jaal across her shoulder and front.
MUSE: a woman in her early thirties with a short pixie-fringe bob, small gold earrings, a nose pin, glass bangles, laughing as a sheet of silver leaf floats off her fingertips.
MOMENT AND PLACE: Late morning in the whitewashed doorway of an old kitchen courtyard, holding a brass tray of kaju katli topped with silver varq at her waist, a tulsi planter softly behind.
LIGHT: Bright side sunlight with warm bounce from the walls; the saffron saree luminous.
COVER FRAMING (this photograph becomes one tall, narrow panel of the lookbook's opening page, behind a large title):
- POSE: she is standing upright, full length, head to toe in frame; ignore any seated or kneeling pose mentioned above.
- HEADROOM: the top quarter of the frame is calm, empty background (sky, wall, foliage or soft darkness); her head sits about a quarter of the way down, never near the top edge.
- Subject centred horizontally and filling the middle third of the width, so a narrow vertical crop keeps all of her.
- Keep the background simple and softly out of focus; nothing busy behind her face.
- CAMERA: eye level, 50mm lens at f/2.8, gentle depth of field, medium-format look with fine grain.
